import type React from "react"
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react"
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "framer-motion"
import Link from "next/link"
import { Calendar, MapPin, Users, ChevronDown, ChevronUp, ExternalLink, Radar, Shield, Eye, Zap } from "lucide-react"
import { ufoTimelineData, getEventData } from "@/data/ufo-timeline-events"

interface FrameRef {
  element: HTMLDivElement | null
  zValue: number
}

const PERSPECTIVE = 800
const Z_SPACING = -2000
const SCROLL_MULTIPLIER = -2 // Negative to move frames towards camera on scroll down

const getClassificationColor = (classification: string) => {
  const colors: Record<string, string> = {
    CE1: "from-cyan-500 to-blue-600",
    CE2: "from-blue-500 to-indigo-600",
    CE3: "from-purple-500 to-pink-600",
    CE4: "from-pink-500 to-red-600",
    Radar: "from-green-500 to-teal-600",
    Military: "from-orange-500 to-amber-600",
    Mass: "from-yellow-500 to-orange-600",
  }
  return colors[classification] || "from-gray-500 to-gray-600"
}

const getClassificationIcon = (classification: string) => {
  const icons: Record<string, React.ReactNode> = {
    CE1: <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE2: <Zap className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE3: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />,
    CE4: <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Radar: <Radar className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Military: <Shield className="w-4 h-4" />,
    Mass: <Users className="w-4 h-4" />,
  }
  return icons[classification] || <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />
}

export default function ZAxisTimeline() {
  const [scrollY, setScrollY] = useState(0)
  const [currentSection, setCurrentSection] = useState(0)

  const lastPosRef = useRef(0)
  const zValues = useRef<number[]>([])
  const framesRef = useRef<(HTMLDivElement | null)[]>([])

  const numSections = ufoTimelineData.length

  useEffect(() => {
    zValues.current = Array.from({ length: numSections }, (_, i) => (numSections - 1 - i) * Z_SPACING)
    framesRef.current = framesRef.current.slice(0, numSections)

    console.log("[v0] Initialized zValues:", zValues.current)
  }, [numSections])

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleScroll = () => {
      const top = document.documentElement.scrollTop || document.body.scrollTop
      const delta = lastPosRef.current - top
      lastPosRef.current = top
      setScrollY(top)

      let closestSection = 0
      let closestDistance = Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY

      for (let i = 0; i < framesRef.current.length; i++) {
        const frame = framesRef.current[i]
        if (!frame) continue

        zValues.current[i] += delta * SCROLL_MULTIPLIER

        const newZVal = zValues.current[i]

        let opacity = 1
        let display = "flex"

        if (newZVal > PERSPECTIVE) {
          display = "none"
          opacity = 0
        } else if (newZVal > 0) {
          opacity = 1 - newZVal / PERSPECTIVE
        } else if (newZVal < -PERSPECTIVE * 4) {
          opacity = Math.max(0, 1 + (newZVal + PERSPECTIVE * 4) / PERSPECTIVE)
        }

        const distance = Math.abs(newZVal)
        if (distance < closestDistance && newZVal <= 100 && newZVal > -PERSPECTIVE * 3) {
          closestDistance = distance
          closestSection = i
        }

        frame.style.transform = `translateZ(${newZVal}px)`
        frame.style.opacity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, opacity)).toString()
        frame.style.display = display
        frame.style.zIndex = (1000 - i).toString()
      }

      setCurrentSection(closestSection)
    }

    window.addEventListener("scroll", handleScroll, { passive: true })

    handleScroll()

    return () => window.removeEventListener("scroll", handleScroll)
  }, [numSections])

  const scrollToSection = (index: number) => {
    const targetZ = 0
    const currentZ = zValues.current[index] || 0
    const scrollDelta = (currentZ - targetZ) / SCROLL_MULTIPLIER

    window.scrollBy({
      top: scrollDelta,
      behavior: "smooth",
    })
  }

  const navigateSection = (direction: "prev" | "next") => {
    const newIndex =
      direction === "prev" ? Math.max(0, currentSection - 1) : Math.min(numSections - 1, currentSection + 1)
    scrollToSection(newIndex)
  }

  return (
    <>
      <div className="relative" style={{ height: `${numSections * 100 + 100}vh` }}>
        <div className="fixed inset-0 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-background">
            <div className="absolute inset-0 stars-bg opacity-50" />
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-b from-transparent via-background/50 to-background" />
          </div>

          <div
            className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
            style={{
              perspective: `${PERSPECTIVE}px`,
              perspectiveOrigin: "50% 50%",
              transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
            }}
          >
            {ufoTimelineData.map((section, index) => {
              const eventData = getEventData(section.events[0]?.id || "")

              return (
                <div
                  key={section.year}
                  ref={(el) => {
                    framesRef.current[index] = el
                  }}
                  className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center"
                  style={{
                    transformStyle: "preserve-3d",
                    backfaceVisibility: "hidden",
                    transform: `translateZ(${zValues.current[index] ?? (numSections - 1 - index) * Z_SPACING}px)`,
                  }}
                >
                  <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden">
                    {section.backgroundImage && (
                      <>
                        <img
                          src={section.backgroundImage || "/placeholder.svg"}
                          alt={section.description}
                          className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full object-cover"
                        />
                        <div className="absolute inset-0" style={{ backgroundColor: section.backgroundOverlay }} />
                      </>
                    )}
                    {!section.backgroundImage && (
                      <div
                        className="absolute inset-0"
                        style={{ backgroundColor: section.backgroundColor || "var(--background)" }}
                      />
                    )}
                    <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_center,transparent_0%,rgba(0,0,0,0.7)_100%)]" />
                  </div>

                  <div className="relative z-10 max-w-lg mx-4">
                    <div className="flex justify-center mb-4">
                      <div className="relative">
                        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-primary/30 blur-xl rounded-full" />
                        <div className="relative px-6 py-2 bg-background/80 backdrop-blur-md border border-primary/50 rounded-full">
                          <span className="text-4xl font-bold text-primary font-mono">{section.year}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {eventData && (
                      <div className="bg-card/90 backdrop-blur-md border border-border/50 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl">
                        <div
                          className={`px-6 py-3 bg-gradient-to-r ${getClassificationColor(eventData.classification)} flex items-center gap-2`}
                        >
                          {getClassificationIcon(eventData.classification)}
                          <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-white">{eventData.classification}</span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="p-6">
                          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground mb-2">{eventData.title}</h2>

                          <p className="text-muted-foreground mb-4 leading-relaxed">{eventData.description}</p>

                          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground mb-4">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {section.events[0]?.date}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {eventData.location.split(",")[0]}
                            </div>
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                              {eventData.witnesses.toLocaleString()} witnesses
                            </div>
                          </div>

                          <Link
                            href={`/content-card-detail-view?id=${section.events[0]?.id}`}
                            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-primary/20 hover:bg-primary/30 
                              text-primary rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium"
                          >
                            Explore Case
                            <ExternalLink className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Link>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="fixed left-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex flex-col gap-2 z-50">
            {ufoTimelineData.map((section, index) => (
              <button
                key={section.year}
                onClick={() => scrollToSection(index)}
                className={`group relative flex items-center gap-3 transition-all duration-300 ${
                  index === currentSection ? "scale-110" : "opacity-50 hover:opacity-100"
                }`}
              >
                <div
                  className={`w-3 h-3 rounded-full transition-all ${
                    index === currentSection
                      ? "bg-primary shadow-lg shadow-primary/50"
                      : "bg-muted-foreground/50 group-hover:bg-muted-foreground"
                  }`}
                />
                <AnimatePresence>
                  {index === currentSection && (
                    <motion.span
                      initial={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
                      animate={{ opacity: 1, x: 0 }}
                      exit={{ opacity: 0, x: -10 }}
                      className="text-sm font-mono text-primary whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      {section.year}
                    </motion.span>
                  )}
                </AnimatePresence>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="fixed right-6 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 flex flex-col gap-4 z-50">
            <button
              onClick={() => navigateSection("prev")}
              disabled={currentSection === 0}
              className="p-3 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-full
                hover:bg-card transition-all disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <ChevronUp className="w-5 h-5 text-foreground" />
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => navigateSection("next")}
              disabled={currentSection === numSections - 1}
              className="p-3 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-full
                hover:bg-card transition-all disabled:opacity-30 disabled:cursor-not-allowed"
            >
              <ChevronDown className="w-5 h-5 text-foreground" />
            </button>
          </div>

          <AnimatePresence>
            {currentSection === 0 && (
              <motion.div
                initial={{ opacity: 0 }}
                animate={{ opacity: 1 }}
                exit={{ opacity: 0 }}
                className="fixed bottom-8 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 z-50"
              >
                <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">Scroll to explore</span>
                <motion.div animate={{ y: [0, 8, 0] }} transition={{ repeat: Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY, duration: 1.5 }}>
                  <ChevronDown className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
                </motion.div>
              </motion.div>
            )}
          </AnimatePresence>

          <div className="fixed bottom-8 right-6 z-50">
            <div className="bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border border-border rounded-xl px-4 py-2">
              <span className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary font-mono">{currentSection + 1}</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1">/</span>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground font-mono">{numSections}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <style jsx global>{`
        .stars-bg {
          background-image: 
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px, rgba(255,255,255,0.8), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 160px 120px, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 230px 80px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 150px, rgba(255,255,255,0.7), transparent),
            radial-gradient(1px 1px at 370px 200px, white, transparent),
            radial-gradient(2px 2px at 450px 50px, rgba(255,255,255,0.8), transparent);
          background-size: 500px 300px;
          animation: twinkle 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes twinkle {
          0%, 100% { opacity: 0.5; }
          50% { opacity: 0.8; }
        }
      `}</style>
    </>
  )
}

        "contents": "import { ThreeDTimelineJourney } from '@/features/3d/3d-timeline-journey'\n\nimport { getXataClient } from '@db'\nimport { Suspense } from 'react'\n\nconst xata = getXataClient()\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  const records: any = await xata.db.events\n    .sort( 'date', 'desc' )\n    .select( [\n      'name',\n      'description',\n      'location',\n      'latitude',\n      'longitude',\n      'date',\n      'photos',\n      'photos.signedUrl',\n      'photos.enablePublicUrl',\n      {\n        name: '\u003c-event-subject-matter-experts.event',\n        columns: ['*'],\n        as: 'experts',\n      },\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const expertPersonnel = await xata.db['event-subject-matter-experts']\n    .select( [\n      'event.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.name',\n      'subject-matter-expert.photo',\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const personnel = expertPersonnel\n    .toSerializable()\n    .map( ( { event, id, xata: xataMeta, ...rest } ) =\u003e ( {\n      ...rest['subject-matter-expert'],\n      eventId: event?.id,\n    } ) )\n\n  const data = records.toSerializable()\n\n  const events = data.map( ( event: { experts: { records: any[] } } ) =\u003e {\n    if ( event?.experts?.records ) {\n      const experts = event.experts.records.map( ( expert ) =\u003e expert )\n      return {\n        ...event,\n        experts,\n      }\n    }\n    return event\n  } )\n\n  const removeEmptyKeys = ( obj: any ) =\u003e {\n    const newObj: any = {}\n    for ( const key in obj ) {\n      if ( obj[key] \u0026\u0026 obj[key].length ) {\n        newObj[key] = obj[key]\n      }\n    }\n    return newObj\n  }\n  function removeLeadingZero( input ) {\n    const str = String( input )\n    return str.startsWith( '0' ) ? str.slice( 1 ) : str\n  }\n\n  const eventsByYear: any = removeEmptyKeys\n\n}",

        "contents": "## 🎯 Feature 1: Timeline Scrubber\n\n### Purpose\nProvide chronological navigation through UFO history with intuitive controls for exploring temporal patterns and key historical events.\n\n### Visual Reference\nBased on screenshot showing:\n- Year display: \"2004\" with era label \"Modern UFO Era\"\n- Timeline slider: 1600-2024 range\n- Playback controls: back, play, forward, speed selector\n- Historical Eras panel with event counts\n- Key Dates display\n- Quick Jump buttons (1947, 2004, 2017)\n\n### Data Architecture\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Core Types\ninterface TimelineEra {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n  range: [number, number] // [start year, end year]\n  eventCount: number\n  description: string\n  color: string // theme color for UI consistency\n  icon?: string\n}\n\ninterface TimelineEvent {\n  id: string\n  title: string\n  date: Date\n  year: number\n  category: string[]\n  isKeyEvent: boolean\n  eventType: 'event' | 'sighting'\n  significance?: number // 0-100 scale\n}\n\ninterface TimelineState {\n  currentYear: number\n  currentDate: Date\n  isPlaying: boolean\n  playbackSpeed: number // 1, 2, 5, 10, 20\n  selectedEra: TimelineEra | null\n  keyEventsFilter: boolean\n  animationFrame: number | null\n}\n\ninterface TimelinePlaybackConfig {\n  minYear: number // 1600\n  maxYear: number // 2024\n  defaultSpeed: number // 1\n  stepSizeYears: number // 1\n  updateIntervalMs: number // 100\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Era Classification System\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nconst ERA_DEFINITIONS: TimelineEra[] = [\n  {\n    id: 'ancient',\n    name: 'Ancient',\n    range: [0, 1800],",

        "contents": "export function HudUapInterface({\n  initialSightings,\n  events = [],\n  analysisResults,\n  initialLocations,\n}: HudUapInterfaceProps) {\n\n\n  // Animation timeline integration\n  const {\n    currentAnimationDate,\n    animationProgress,\n    visibleData: animatedVisibleData,\n    handleTimeSliceChange,\n    handleAnimationProgress,\n    AnimationTimelineManager,\n  } = useAnimationTimeline(enhancedTimeRange, initialSightings, events)\n\n  // Use animated data when animation is active, otherwise use filtered data\n  const currentSightings = enhancedTimeRange.isAnimating\n    ? animatedVisibleData.sightings\n    : filteredSightings\n  const currentEvents = enhancedTimeRange.isAnimating ? animatedVisibleData.events : filteredEvents\n\n  // Combine sightings and events for visualization\n  const combinedData = React.useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    // Convert events to a compatible format for visualization\n    const formattedEvents = currentEvents.map((event) =\u003e ({\n      id: event.id,\n      type: 'event',\n      title: event.title || event.name || 'Unknown Event',\n      content: event.description || '',\n      location: {\n        city: event.location || '',\n        state: '',\n        coordinates:\n          event.latitude \u0026\u0026 event.longitude\n            ? {lat: event.latitude, lng: event.longitude}\n            : undefined,\n      },\n      timestamp: event.date || new Date(),\n      category: event.category\n        ? Array.isArray(event.category)\n          ? event.category\n          : [event.category]\n        : [],\n      confidence: 'high',\n      sourceUrl: '',\n      mediaUrls: [],\n    }))\n\n    return [...currentSightings, ...formattedEvents]\n  }, [currentSightings, currentEvents])\n\n  // Initialize filters and data\n  useEffect\n\n}",

          {
            "lineNumber": 192,
            "text": "    const formattedEvents = currentEvents.map((event) =\u003e ({"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "      id: event.id,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194,
            "text": "      type: 'event',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "      title: event.title || event.name || 'Unknown Event',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "      content: event.description || '',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197,
            "text": "      location: {"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198,
            "text": "        city: event.location || '',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199,
            "text": "        state: '',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200,
            "text": "        coordinates:"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201,
            "text": "          event.latitude \u0026\u0026 event.longitude"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202,
            "text": "            ? {lat: event.latitude, lng: event.longitude}"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203,
            "text": "            : undefined,"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204,
            "text": "      },"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205,
            "text": "      timestamp: event.date || new Date(),"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206,
            "text": "      category: event.category"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 207,
            "text": "        ? Array.isArray(event.category)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 208,
            "text": "          ? event.category"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 209,
            "text": "          : [event.category]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 210,
            "text": "        : [],"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 211,
            "text": "      confidence: 'high',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212,
            "text": "      sourceUrl: '',"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 213,
            "text": "      mediaUrls: [],"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214,
            "text": "    }))"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216,
            "text": "    return [...currentSightings, ...formattedEvents]"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 217,
            "text": "  }, [currentSightings, currentEvents])"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 219,
            "text": "  // Initialize filters and data"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220,
            "text": "  useEffect"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },

            "isSignature": true,
            "lineNumber": 926,
            "text": "}"
          }

        "contents": "- **Audit Trail**: Complete lineage of documentation changes\n\n### 3. Data Collection Architecture\n\n#### Multi-source Data Integration\n- **System Logs**: Application, server, network, security logs\n- **Monitoring Tools**: Infrastructure monitoring platforms, APM tools\n- **User Reports**: Internal tickets, customer feedback, incident reports\n- **External Feeds**: Vendor notifications, regulatory updates, market data\n- **Sensor Data**: IoT devices, environmental monitors, hardware sensors\n\n#### Collection Protocols\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Example event collection schema\nCREATE TABLE detailed_events (\n    event_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,\n    occurred_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,\n    reported_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,\n    event_type VARCHAR(100),\n    sub_type VARCHAR(100),\n    source_system VARCHAR(100),\n    reporter_id VARCHAR(100),\n    severity ENUM('critical','high','medium','low','info'),\n    impact_score DECIMAL(3,2),\n    affected_components JSONB,\n    description TEXT,\n    resolution_status VARCHAR(50),\n    root_cause_analysis JSONB,\n    lessons_learned TEXT[]\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 4. Analysis Framework and Methodologies\n\n#### Temporal Analysis\n- **Event Sequence Mapping**: Chronological reconstruction of cascading effects\n- **Pattern Recognition**: Recurring themes, cycles, and correlations\n- **Duration Impact Analysis**: Long-term vs. short-term consequence evaluation\n- **Seasonal/Trend Analysis**: Time-based variations and predictable patterns\n\n#### Clustering and Segmentation\n- **Impact-based Clustering**: Grouping events by magnitude and scope\n- **Component-centric Analysis**: Focused analysis on specific systems/processes\n- **Stakeholder Impact Analysis**: Effects on different organizational groups\n- **Financial Impact Segmentation**: Cost categorization and ROI calculations\n\n#### Root Cause Analysis Techniques\n1. **5 Whys Analysis**: Deep dive into causal chains\n2. **Fishbone Diagrams**: Visual cause-effect relationships\n3. **Fault Tree Analysis**: Systematic failure pathway mapping\n4. **Barrier Analysis**: Identification of failed or missing controls\n5. **Change Impact Analysis**: Evaluation of change-induced events",

photos (file[], defaultPublicAccess: true)\n  - title (string, unique)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 1536)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - topic-subject-matter-experts (topic)\n  - topics-testimonies (topic)\n  - event-topic-subject-matter-experts (topic)\n  - user-saved-topics (topic)\n\n## personnel\n\n- **Columns:**\n  - bio (text)\n  - role (string)\n  - photo (file[])\n  - rank (int)\n  - credibility (int)\n  - popularity (int)\n  - name (string, unique)\n  - authority (int)\n  - embedding (vector, dimension: 1536)\n- **Referenced by:**\n  - organization-members (member)\n  - event-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - topic-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - testimonies (witness)\n  - event-topic-subject-matter-experts (subject-matter-expert)\n  - user-saved-key-figure (key-figure)\n  - documents (author)\n\n## events\n\n- **Columns:**\n  - name (text)\n  - description (text)\n  - location (string)\n  - latitude (float)\n  - longitude (float)\n  - date (datetime)\n  - photos (file[])\n  - metadata (json, defaultValue: \"{}\")\n  - title (string, unique)\n  -         "contents": "# Database State Analysis - Xata Instance\n\n## Schema Overview\n\n### Core Entity Tables (28 tables total)\n\n#### Primary Research Entities (Vector-Enabled):\n1. **topics** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, summary, photo, photos[], title (unique), embedding\n   - Relationships: Connected to testimonies, experts, users\n\n2. **personnel** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: bio, role, photo[], rank, credibility, popularity, name (unique), authority, embedding\n   - Relationships: Subject matter experts, witnesses, authors, key figures\n\n3. **events** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, description, location, latitude, longitude, date, photos[], metadata (JSON), title (unique), summary, category, embedding\n   - Relationships: Connected to experts, testimonies, topics\n\n4. **organizations** (500d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name, specialization, description, photo, image, title (unique), embedding\n   - Relationships: Members, testimonies, documents\n\n5. **testimonies** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: claim, event (link), summary, witness (link), documentation[], date, organization (link), source, media[], context, embedding\n   - Relationships: Events, witnesses, topics\n\n6. **documents** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: file[], summary, embedding, title, date, author (link), organization (link), url, metadata (JSON), images[], processed (bool)\n   - Relationships: Authors, organizations, summary files\n\n7. **artifacts** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: name (unique), description, photos[], date, source, origin, images[], embedding\n   - Relationships: Standalone entity\n\n8. **mindmaps** (1536d embeddings)\n   - Columns: json (JSON), embedding, user (link), file\n   - Relationships: User-created content\n\n#### Geographic \u0026 Observational Data:\n9. **sightings**\n   - Columns: date, description, media_link, city, state, country, shape, duration_seconds, duration_hours_min, comments, date_posted, latitude, longitude, media[]\n   - Relationships: User saved items\n\n10. **locations**\n    - Columns: name, coordinates, google-maps-location-id, city, state, latitude, longitude",

        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useState } from \"react\"\nimport { Clock, Calendar, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Play, Pause } from \"lucide-react\"\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\nimport { Slider } from \"@/components/ui/slider\"\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\"\nimport { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from \"@/components/ui/select\"\n\nconst TIMELINE_ERAS = [\n  { name: \"Ancient\", range: \"Pre-1800\", start: 1600, end: 1800, events: 23 },\n  { name: \"Industrial\", range: \"1800-1900\", start: 1800, end: 1900, events: 45 },\n  { name: \"Early Modern\", range: \"1900-1947\", start: 1900, end: 1947, events: 127 },\n  { name: \"Modern UFO Era\", range: \"1947-1990\", start: 1947, end: 1990, events: 2341 },\n  { name: \"Contemporary\", range: \"1990-Present\", start: 1990, end: 2024, events: 1876 },\n]\n\nconst KEY_DATES = [\n  { year: 1947, label: \"Roswell Incident\", type: \"event\" },\n  { year: 1952, label: \"Project Blue Book\", type: \"program\" },\n  { year: 1969, label: \"Blue Book Closure\", type: \"program\" },\n  { year: 2004, label: \"Nimitz Encounter\", type: \"event\" },\n  { year: 2017, label: \"Pentagon Disclosure\", type: \"disclosure\" },\n  { year: 2020, label: \"UAP Task Force\", type: \"program\" },\n  { year: 2023, label: \"Grusch Testimony\", type: \"disclosure\" },\n]\n\nconst EVENT_TYPES = {\n  event: \"bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30\",\n  program: \"bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30\",\n  disclosure: \"bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30\",\n}\n\nexport function TimelinePanel() {\n  const [currentYear, setCurrentYear] = useState([2004])\n}",

        "contents": "&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nexport const PROVIDERS = {\n  xata: {\n    client: xata,\n  },\n  // Extensible for future providers (Supabase, Convex, etc.)\n} as const;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### 2. **Xata TypeScript SDK** (&#96;src/xata-typescript-sdk/&#96;)\n\n- **Client**: Database connection and configuration management\n- **Models**: 15+ entity definitions with CRUD operations\n- **API**: Advanced search, AI, and integration functions\n- **Types**: Comprehensive TypeScript definitions\n\n#### 3. **Entity Models** (15+ specialized models)\n\n- **Core Entities**: &#96;topics&#96;, &#96;events&#96;, &#96;personnel&#96;, &#96;organizations&#96;\n- **Research Data**: &#96;testimonies&#96;, &#96;sightings&#96;, &#96;documents&#96;, &#96;locations&#96;\n- **Specialized**: &#96;artifacts&#96;, &#96;mindmaps&#96;, &#96;theories&#96;, &#96;tags&#96;\n- **Relationships**: Junction tables and cross-references\n\n---\n\n## 📊 **Database Schema**\n\n### **Primary Entities**\n\n#### **&#96;topics&#96;** - Research Topics \u0026 Categories\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Topics {\n  name: string;\n  title: string; // unique\n  summary: text;\n  photo: file;\n  photos: file[];\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Rev links: topic-subject-matter-experts, topics-testimonies, etc.\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;events&#96;** - UAP Incidents \u0026 Sightings\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Events {\n  name: string;\n  description: text;\n  date: datetime;\n  location: link\u003cLocations\u003e;\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  credibility_score: int;\n  // Complex relationships with personnel, organizations, testimonies\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;personnel&#96;** - Key Figures in UAP Research\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Personnel {\n  name: string; // unique\n  bio: text;\n  role: string;\n  rank: int;\n  credibility: int;\n  authority: int;\n  popularity: int;\n  photo: file[];\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Rev links: organization-members, subject-matter-experts\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### **&#96;organizations&#96;** - Government Agencies \u0026 Research Groups\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\ninterface Organizations {\n  name: string;\n  description: text;\n  type: string;\n  founded: datetime;\n  location: link\u003cLocations\u003e;\n  embedding: vector[1536];\n  // Relationships with members, events, documents\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### **Advanced Entities**\n\n#### **&#96;testimonies&#96;** - Witness Accounts with Credibility Scoring",

        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport {Clock, Pause, Play} from 'lucide-react'\nimport {Button} from '@/components/ui/button'\nimport {Slider} from '@/components/ui/slider'\nimport {Badge} from '@/components/ui/badge'\nimport {Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue} from '@/components/ui/select'\nimport {CalendarIcon, ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRightIcon} from '@radix-ui/react-icons'\n\nconst TIMELINE_ERAS = [\n  {name: 'Ancient', range: 'Pre-1800', start: 1600, end: 1800, events: 23},\n  {name: 'Industrial', range: '1800-1900', start: 1800, end: 1900, events: 45},\n  {name: 'Early Modern', range: '1900-1947', start: 1900, end: 1947, events: 127},\n  {name: 'Modern UFO Era', range: '1947-1990', start: 1947, end: 1990, events: 2341},\n  {name: 'Contemporary', range: '1990-Present', start: 1990, end: 2024, events: 1876},\n]\n\nconst KEY_DATES = [\n  {year: 1947, label: 'Roswell Incident', type: 'event'},\n  {year: 1952, label: 'Project Blue Book', type: 'program'},\n  {year: 1969, label: 'Blue Book Closure', type: 'program'},\n  {year: 2004, label: 'Nimitz Encounter', type: 'event'},\n  {year: 2017, label: 'Pentagon Disclosure', type: 'disclosure'},\n  {year: 2020, label: 'UAP Task Force', type: 'program'},\n  {year: 2023, label: 'Grusch Testimony', type: 'disclosure'},\n]\n\nconst EVENT_TYPES = {\n  event: 'bg-red-500/20 text-red-400 border-red-500/30',\n  program: 'bg-blue-500/20 text-blue-400 border-blue-500/30',\n  disclosure: 'bg-green-500/20 text-green-400 border-green-500/30',\n}\n\nexport type TimelineRequestPayload = {\n  year: number\n  era: string\n  dateRange?: {\n    startYear: number\n    endYear: number\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface TimelinePanelProps {\n  year: number\n  era: string\n}",

        "contents": "import { ScrollThrough3D } from '@/features/3d/scroll-through-3d'\n\nimport { getXataClient } from '@db'\n\nconst xata = getXataClient()\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  const records: any = await xata.db.events\n    .sort( 'date', 'desc' )\n    .select( [\n      'name',\n      'description',\n      'location',\n      'latitude',\n      'longitude',\n      'date',\n      'photos',\n      'photos.signedUrl',\n      'photos.enablePublicUrl',\n      {\n        name: '\u003c-event-subject-matter-experts.event',\n        columns: ['*'],\n        as: 'experts',\n      },\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const expertPersonnel = await xata.db['event-subject-matter-experts']\n    .select( [\n      'event.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.name',\n      'subject-matter-expert.photo',\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const personnel = expertPersonnel\n    .toSerializable()\n    .map( ( { event, id, xata: xataMeta, ...rest } ) =\u003e ( {\n      ...rest['subject-matter-expert'],\n      eventId: event?.id,\n    } ) )\n\n  const data = records.toSerializable()\n\n  const events = data.map( ( event: { experts: { records: any[] } } ) =\u003e {\n    if ( event?.experts?.records ) {\n      const experts = event.experts.records.map( ( expert ) =\u003e expert )\n      return {\n        ...event,\n        experts,\n      }\n    }\n    return event\n  } )\n\n  const removeEmptyKeys = ( obj: any ) =\u003e {\n    const newObj: any = {}\n    for ( const key in obj ) {\n      if ( obj[key] \u0026\u0026 obj[key].length ) {\n        newObj[key] = obj[key]\n      }\n    }\n    return newObj\n  }\n  function removeLeadingZero( input ) {\n    const str = String( input )\n    return str.startsWith( '0' ) ? str.slice( 1 ) : str\n  }\n\n  const eventsByYear: any = removeEmptyKeys\n\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport {\n\tOrbitControls,\n\tPerspectiveCamera,\n\tuseTexture,\n} from \"@react-three/drei\";\nimport { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from \"@react-three/fiber\";\nimport { useEffect, useMemo, useRef } from \"react\";\nimport * as THREE from \"three\";\n\n// Constants for the helix\nconst PARTICLES_PER_CURVE = 1200;\nconst CURVES = 2;\nconst RADIUS = 4;\nconst HELIX_RADIUS = 2;\nconst ROTATION_SPEED = 0.2;\nconst PARTICLE_SIZE = 0.06;\nconst COLOR_SHIFT_SPEED = 0.5;\nconst TWO_PI = Math.PI * 2;\nconst EIGHT_PI = Math.PI * 8;\n\n// Helix component\nfunction Helix({ mousePosition }: { mousePosition: { x: number; y: number } }) {\n\tconst points = useRef\u003cTHREE.Vector3[][]\u003e([]);\n\tconst particles = useRef\u003cTHREE.Points\u003e(null);\n\tconst { camera } = useThree();\n\n\t// Use SharedArrayBuffer for better performance with Bun\n\tconst positions = useRef(new Float32Array(PARTICLES_PER_CURVE * CURVES * 3));\n\tconst colors = useRef(new Float32Array(PARTICLES_PER_CURVE * CURVES * 3));\n\tconst sizes = useRef(new Float32Array(PARTICLES_PER_CURVE * CURVES));\n\n\t// Load texture with suspense\n\tconst particleTexture = useTexture(\"/particle.png\");\n\n\t// Initialize particles\n\tuseEffect(() =\u003e {\n\t\t// Use Web Workers for initialization if complex calculations are needed\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "import * as THREE from 'three'\nimport {\n  createContext,\n  useMemo,\n  useRef,\n  useState,\n  useContext,\n  useLayoutEffect,\n  forwardRef,\n  useEffect,\n} from 'react'\nimport { useFrame, useThree } from '@react-three/fiber'\nimport {\n  Box,\n  DragControls,\n  Html,\n  Plane,\n  QuadraticBezierLine,\n  Text,\n  View,\n} from '@react-three/drei'\nimport { useDrag } from '@use-gesture/react'\nimport {\n  StarsCard,\n  StarsCardDescription,\n  StarsCardTitle,\n} from '@/components/ui/card/stars-card'\n\nconst context = createContext( null )\n\nconst Circle = forwardRef(\n  (\n    {\n      children,\n      opacity = 1,\n      radius = 0.05,\n      segments = 32,\n      color = '#ff1050',\n      ...props\n    }: any,\n    ref: any\n  ) =\u003e (\n    \u003cmesh ref={ref} {...props}\u003e\n      \u003ccircleGeometry args={[radius, segments]} /\u003e\n      \u003cmeshBasicMaterial\n        transparent={opacity \u003c 1}\n        opacity={opacity}\n        color={color}\n      /\u003e\n      {children}\n    \u003c/mesh\u003e\n  )\n)\nCircle.displayName = 'Circle'\n// const center = d3.forceCenter(width / 2, height / 2);\n// const link = d3.forceLink(links).id((d) =\u003e d.id);\n// const manyBody = d3.forceManyBody().strength(-100);\n// const x = d3.forceX(width / 2);\n\nfunction force( nodes: any, alpha: number ) {\n  for ( let i = 0, n = nodes.length, node, k = alpha * 0.1; i \u003c n; ++i ) {\n    node = nodes[i]\n    node.vx -= node.x * k\n    node.vy -= node.y * k\n  }\n}\n\nexport function Nodes( { children }: any ) {\n  const group: any = useRef()\n}",
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "lineNumber": 1,
            "text": "import * as THREE from 'three'"

        "contents": "'use client'\n\nimport { forwardRef, Suspense, useImperativeHandle, useRef } from 'react'\nimport { OrbitControls, PerspectiveCamera, View as ViewImpl } from '@react-three/drei'\nimport { Three } from '@/helpers/components/Three'\n\nexport const Common = ({ color }) =\u003e (\n  \u003cSuspense fallback={null}\u003e\n    {color \u0026\u0026 \u003ccolor attach='background' args={[color]} /\u003e}\n    \u003cambientLight /\u003e\n    \u003cpointLight position={[20, 30, 10]} intensity={3} decay={0.2} /\u003e\n    \u003cpointLight position={[-10, -10, -10]} color='blue' decay={0.2} /\u003e\n    \u003cPerspectiveCamera makeDefault fov={40} position={[0, 0, 6]} /\u003e\n  \u003c/Suspense\u003e\n)\n\nconst View = forwardRef(({ children, orbit, ...props }, ref) =\u003e {\n  const localRef = useRef(null)\n  useImperativeHandle(ref, () =\u003e localRef.current)\n\n  return (\n    \u003c\u003e\n      \u003cdiv ref={localRef} {...props} /\u003e\n      \u003cThree\u003e\n        \u003cViewImpl track={localRef}\u003e\n          {children}\n          {orbit \u0026\u0026 \u003cOrbitControls /\u003e}\n        \u003c/ViewImpl\u003e\n      \u003c/Three\u003e\n    \u003c/\u003e\n  )\n})\nView.displayName = 'View'\n\nexport { View }",

        "contents": "'use client'\n\n\nimport { useGLTF } from '@react-three/drei'\nimport { useFrame } from '@react-three/fiber'\nimport { useRef } from 'react'\nimport * as THREE from 'three'\nexport function UFOScene( { offset = 0, ...props }: any ) {\n  const meshRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Mesh\u003e()\n  const lightRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.SpotLight\u003e()\n\n  // Preload the model\n  useGLTF.preload( '/assets/ufo/ufo.glb' )\n\n  const { nodes, materials } = useGLTF( '/assets/ufo/scene.gltf' )\n\n  console.log( \"🚀 ~ file: UFO.tsx:17 ~ UFOScene ~ nodes:\", nodes )\n\n\n  // Add hovering animation\n  useFrame( ( state, delta ) =\u003e {\n    if ( meshRef.current ) {\n      // Rotate slowly\n      meshRef.current.rotation.y += delta * 0.2\n      // Add subtle hovering effect\n      meshRef.current.position.y = Math.sin( state.clock.elapsedTime ) * 0.1\n    }\n  } )\n\n  return (\n    \u003cgroup {...props} dispose={null}\u003e\n      \u003cmesh\n        ref={meshRef}\n        // geometry={nodes.UFO.geometry}\n        material={materials.UFO_material}\n        scale={0.5}\n      \u003e\n        {/* Add glowing effect with point lights */}\n        \u003cpointLight\n          position={[0, 0.2, 0]}\n          intensity={2}\n          color=\"#4af2d6\"\n          distance={3}\n        /\u003e\n      \u003c/mesh\u003e\n\n      {/* Add atmospheric lighting */}\n      \u003cgroup ref={lightRef}\u003e\n        \u003cspotLight\n          position={[5, 5, 0]}\n          intensity={1}\n          angle={0.2}\n          penumbra={1}\n          color=\"#ffffff\"\n        /\u003e\n      \u003c/group\u003e\n    \u003c/group\u003e\n  )\n}",

        "contents": "export const extractUniqueYearsFromEvents = (events: unknown[]) =\u003e {\n\tconst years = new Set();\n\tevents.sort((a, b) =\u003e {\n\t\tconst dateA = new Date(a.date);\n\n\t\tconst dateB = new Date(b.date);\n\t\treturn dateB.getTime() - dateA.getTime();\n\t});\n\tfor (const event of events) {\n\t\t// @ts-ignore\n\t\tconst year: unknown = removeLeadingZero(event?.date?.split(\"-\")[0]);\n\n\t\tif (!years.has(year)) {\n\t\t\tyears.add(year);\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn Array.from(years);\n};\nexport const extractCoordinatesFromEvents = (\n\tevents: unknown[],\n\twithEventData = false,\n)\n;",

        "contents": "export class IntelligentNarrativeLayout {\n\n  \n  // Helper methods\n  \n  private extractDateFromNode(node: Node): Date | null {\n    const dateFields = ['date', 'timestamp', 'dateTime', 'eventDate', 'createdAt']\n    \n    for (const field of dateFields) {\n      const dateValue = node.data?.[field]\n      if (dateValue) {\n        const date = new Date(dateValue as string)\n        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {\n          return date\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    \n    return null\n  }\n  \n  private containsHistoricalKeywords(text: string): boolean {\n    const keywords = ['roswell']\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "import { xata } from '@/db/xata/client';\n\n/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n  startYear: number = 1940,\n  endYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n  limit: number = 100\n) {\n  try {\n    // Calculate date range\n    const startDate = new Date(&#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96;);\n    const endDate = new Date(&#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96;);\n\n    // Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n    const eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n      .filter({\n        date: {\n          $ge: startDate,\n          $le: endDate\n        }\n      })\n      .sort('date', 'desc')\n      .getPaginated({\n        pagination: {\n          size: limit\n        }\n      });\n\n    return eventsRecords.records;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error fetching events by time chunk:', error);\n    return [];\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */",

        "contents": "---\ndescription: Standardize human-readable date formatting and documentation metadata (authorship vs repo-added) across the project\nglobs: **/*.md, **/*.mdc, **/*.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}\nalwaysApply: false\n---\n\n- **Human‑Readable Date Format (UI/Docs)**\n  - Use: \"June 12th 2005\" (token pattern: &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;)\n  - Ordinal day required (&#96;1st&#96;, &#96;2nd&#96;, &#96;3rd&#96;, &#96;4th&#96;, ...)\n  - Prefer locale &#96;en-US&#96;\n\n- **Machine/Metadata Date Format**\n  - Use ISO 8601 UTC: &#96;YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ&#96; (e.g., &#96;2025-06-12T00:00:00Z&#96;)\n  - Front matter fields for docs: &#96;created&#96;, &#96;lastUpdated&#96;\n  - Do not store ordinals in metadata; ordinals are display-only\n\n- **Semantics: Created vs Added to Repo**\n  - **Created (authorship)**: the document’s authoring date (front matter/header)\n  - **Added to Repo**: earliest Git author date for the file (first commit adding it)\n  - When communicating dates, prefer authorship for content provenance, and explicitly note repo-added when relevant to VCS history\n\n- **Approved Libraries/Patterns**\n  - &#96;date-fns&#96; UI formatting: &#96;format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy')&#96;\n  - &#96;dayjs&#96; (if already present in the module) with &#96;advancedFormat&#96; plugin: &#96;dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY')&#96;\n  - Avoid raw &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat&#96; for ordinals (no native ordinal support)\n\n- **Code Examples (update existing patterns)**\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n  // date-fns (Before → After)\n  import { format } from 'date-fns'\n  const before = format(date, 'MMMM d, yyyy')\n  const after  = format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy') // \"June 12th 2005\"\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n  // dayjs with advancedFormat (only where dayjs is already used)\n  import dayjs from 'dayjs'\n  import advancedFormat from 'dayjs/plugin/advancedFormat'\n  dayjs.extend(advancedFormat)\n  const s = dayjs(date).format('MMMM Do YYYY') // \"June 12th 2005\"\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- **Front Matter Template (Markdown)**\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;yaml\n  ---\n  title: My Document\n  description: Short purpose statement",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "---"

            "lineNumber": 2,
            "text": "description: Standardize human-readable date formatting and documentation metadata (authorship vs repo-added) across the project"

            "lineNumber": 7,
            "text": "- **Human‑Readable Date Format (UI/Docs)**"

            "lineNumber": 8,
            "text": "  - Use: \"June 12th 2005\" (token pattern: &#96;MMMM do yyyy&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 9,
            "text": "  - Ordinal day required (&#96;1st&#96;, &#96;2nd&#96;, &#96;3rd&#96;, &#96;4th&#96;, ...)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10,
            "text": "  - Prefer locale &#96;en-US&#96;"

            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12,
            "text": "- **Machine/Metadata Date Format**"

            "lineNumber": 13,
            "text": "  - Use ISO 8601 UTC: &#96;YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ&#96; (e.g., &#96;2025-06-12T00:00:00Z&#96;)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14,
            "text": "  - Front matter fields for docs: &#96;created&#96;, &#96;lastUpdated&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15,
            "text": "  - Do not store ordinals in metadata; ordinals are display-only"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17,
            "text": "- **Semantics: Created vs Added to Repo**"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 18,
            "text": "  - **Created (authorship)**: the document’s authoring date (front matter/header)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19,
            "text": "  - **Added to Repo**: earliest Git author date for the file (first commit adding it)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20,
            "text": "  - When communicating dates, prefer authorship for content provenance, and explicitly note repo-added when relevant to VCS history"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22,
            "text": "- **Approved Libraries/Patterns**"

            "lineNumber": 23,
            "text": "  - &#96;date-fns&#96; UI formatting: &#96;format(date, 'MMMM do yyyy')&#96;"

        "contents": "/**\n * Fetch events within a specified time range, with pagination\n * @param startYear Starting year for the query\n * @param endYear Ending year for the query\n * @param limit Maximum number of records to return\n */\nexport async function getEventsByTimeChunk(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n\tlimit = 100,\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date( &#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96; )\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date( &#96;${endYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96; )\n\n\t\t// Use Xata's filter to get events within date range\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter( \"date\", { $ge: startDate, $le: endDate } )\n\t\t\t.sort( \"date\", \"desc\" )\n\t\t\t.getPaginated( {\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: Math.min(limit, 200), // Respect Xata's 200 record limit\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t} )\n\n\t\treturn eventsRecords.records\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error fetching events by time chunk:\", error )\n\t\treturn []\n\t}\n}\n\n/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */",

        "contents": "/**\n * Get aggregate statistics for events based on time range\n * Uses Xata's aggregate functionality for efficient computation\n */\nexport async function getEventsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n) {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Calculate date range\n\t\tconst startDate = new Date( &#96;${startYear}-01-01T00:00:00Z&#96; )\n\n\t\t// Ensure we don't query future years beyond the current year\n\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n\t\tconst maxAllowedYear = Math.min( endYear, currentYear )\n\t\tconst endDate = new Date( &#96;${maxAllowedYear}-12-31T23:59:59Z&#96; )\n\n    debugLog( \"🔍 Events: Using date range:\", startDate.toISOString(), \"to\", endDate.toISOString() )\n\n\t\t// Category aggregation removed per requirement\n\n\t\t// Get time series data by year - simplified without date filters for now\n\t\tconst timeSeriesAggregation = ( await xata.db.events.aggregate( {\n\t\t\teventsByYear: {\n\t\t\t\tdateHistogram: {\n\t\t\t\t\tcolumn: \"date\",\n\t\t\t\t\tcalendarInterval: \"year\",\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} ) ) as unknown as XataAggregationResult\n\n\t\t// Fetch events to process location data with coordinates (limited)\n\t\tconst eventsRecords = await xata.db.events\n\t\t\t.filter( \"date\", { $ge: startDate, $le: endDate } )\n\t\t\t.getPaginated( {\n\t\t\t\tpagination: {\n\t\t\t\t\tsize: 200, // Maximum safe limit for Xata\n\t\t\t\t},\n\t\t\t} )\n\n\t\t// Process location data to include coordinates\n\t\tconst locationGroups = new Map\u003c\n\t\t\tstring,\n\t\t\t{\n\t\t\t\tlocation: string\n\t\t\t\tcoordinates: { lat: number; lng: number } | null\n\t\t\t\tcount: number\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\u003e()\n\n\t\tfor ( const event of eventsRecords.records )\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export async function getEventsStats(\n\tstartYear = 1940,\n\tendYear: number = new Date().getFullYear(),\n) {\n\n\n\t\t// After getting the timeSeriesAggregation, add a normalization step for the dates\n\t\tconst normalizedTimeSeriesData =\n\t\t\ttimeSeriesAggregation.aggs.eventsByYear?.values?.map( ( item ) =\u003e {\n\t\t\t\t// Check if the date appears to be missing the millennium or is in the future\n\t\t\t\tif ( item.$key \u0026\u0026 typeof item.$key === \"string\" ) {\n\t\t\t\t\ttry {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst dateStr = item.$key\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst parsedDate = new Date( dateStr )\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst year = parsedDate.getFullYear()\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconst currentYear = new Date().getFullYear()\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// Filter out future dates beyond next year (allow some buffer)\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif ( year \u003e currentYear + 1 ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log( &#96;⚠️ Filtering out future date: ${dateStr} (year ${year})&#96; )\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tvalue: dateStr,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcount: 0, // Set count to 0 to exclude from visualizations\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// If we got a very old year (like 196 instead of 1996 or 2196)\n\t\t\t\t\t\t// assume it's a modern date missing the millennium\n\t\t\t\t\t\tif ( year \u003c 1000 ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Determine if this should be 1900s or 2000s based on the original 2-digit year\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tlet correctedYear\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tif ( year \u003c 70 ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcorrectedYear = 2000 + year // 0-69 -\u003e 2000-2069\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t} else {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcorrectedYear = 1900 + year // 70-99 -\u003e 1970-1999\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t// Create new date with corrected year\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconst correctedDate = new Date( parsedDate )\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcorrectedDate.setFullYear( correctedYear )\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\t&#96;🔄 Corrected malformed date: ${dateStr} → ${correctedDate.toISOString()}&#96;,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tvalue: correctedDate.toISOString(),\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t\tcount: item.$count,\n\t\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tconsole.error( &#96;Error fixing malformed date: ${item.$key}&#96;, error )\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t\t// If no correction needed or if correction failed, return original\n\t\t\t\treturn {\n\t\t\t\t\tvalue: item.$key,\n\t\t\t\t\tcount: item.$count,\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t} ) ?? []\n\n\t\t// Filter out any future dates beyond current year + 1\n}",

        "contents": "import { ThreeDTimelineJourney } from '@/features/3d/3d-timeline-journey'\n\nimport { getXataClient } from '@db'\nimport { Suspense } from 'react'\n\nconst xata = getXataClient()\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  const records: any = await xata.db.events\n    .sort( 'date', 'desc' )\n    .select( [\n      'name',\n      'description',\n      'location',\n      'latitude',\n      'longitude',\n      'date',\n      'photos',\n      'photos.signedUrl',\n      'photos.enablePublicUrl',\n      {\n        name: '\u003c-event-subject-matter-experts.event',\n        columns: ['*'],\n        as: 'experts',\n      },\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const expertPersonnel = await xata.db['event-subject-matter-experts']\n    .select( [\n      'event.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.id',\n      'subject-matter-expert.name',\n      'subject-matter-expert.photo',\n    ] )\n    .getAll()\n\n  const personnel = expertPersonnel\n    .toSerializable()\n    .map( ( { event, id, xata: xataMeta, ...rest } ) =\u003e ( {\n      ...rest['subject-matter-expert'],\n      eventId: event?.id,\n    } ) )\n\n  const data = records.toSerializable()\n\n  const events = data.map( ( event: { experts: { records: any[] } } ) =\u003e {\n    if ( event?.experts?.records ) {\n      const experts = event.experts.records.map( ( expert ) =\u003e expert )\n      return {\n        ...event,\n        experts,\n      }\n    }\n    return event\n  } )\n\n  const removeEmptyKeys = ( obj: any ) =\u003e {\n    const newObj: any = {}\n    for ( const key in obj ) {\n      if ( obj[key] \u0026\u0026 obj[key].length ) {\n        newObj[key] = obj[key]\n      }\n    }\n    return newObj\n  }\n  function removeLeadingZero( input ) {\n    const str = String( input )\n    return str.startsWith( '0' ) ? str.slice( 1 ) : str\n  }\n\n  const eventsByYear: any = removeEmptyKeys\n\n}",

        "contents": "class UFOTemporalExtractor:\n    \"\"\"Specialized temporal entity extraction for UFO content\"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, resolution: str = \"minute\"):\n        \"\"\"Initialize temporal extractor with specified resolution\"\"\"\n        self.resolution = resolution\n        self.words_per_minute = 150  # animation: redacted-flicker 2s infinite alternate;\n}\n\n@keyframes redacted-flicker {\n  0%,\n  90% {\n    background: #000;\n  }\n  95% {\n    background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);\n  }\n  100% {\n    background: #000;\n  }\n}\n\n/* Scan line effect for text */\n.scan-line-text {\n  position: relative;\n  overflow: hidden;\n}\n\n.scan-line-text::after {\n  content: '';\n  position: absolute;\n  top: 0;\n  left: -100%;\n  width: 100%;\n  height: 100%;\n  background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), transparent);\n  animation: scan-across 3s }\n}\n\n/* Text Effects */\n.text-fragment {\n  filter: blur(0.3px);\n  letter-spacing: -0.5px;\n}\n\n.text-aged {\n  filter: contrast(1.2) brightness(0.95) sepia(0.1);\n}\n\n.text-typewriter {\n  overflow: hidden;\n  border-right: 2px solid;\n  white-space: nowrap;\n  animation:\n    typing 3s steps(40, end),\n    blink-cursor 0.75s step-end infinite;\n}\n\n@keyframes typing {\n  from {\n    width: 0;\n  }\n  to {\n    width: 100%;\n  }\n}\n\n@keyframes blink-cursor {\n  from,\n  to {\n    border-color: transparent;\n  }\n  50% {\n    border-color: currentColor;\n  }\n}\n\n/* Paper texture text overlay */\n.text-on-paper {\n  background: linear-gradient(\n    45deg,\n    transparent 25%,\n    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 25%,\n    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 50%,\n    transparent 50%,\n    transparent 75%,\n    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02) 75%\n  );\n  background-size: 4px 4px;\n}\n\n/* Classification stamps */\n.classified-stamp {\n  position: relative;\n  display: inline-block;\n}\n\n.classified-stamp::before {\n  content: '';\n  position: absolute;\n  inset: -8px;\n  border: 3px solid currentColor;\n  border-radius: 8px;\n  opacity: 0.7;\n  transform: rotate(-5deg);\n  z-index: -1;\n}\n\n.classified-stamp::after {\n  content: 'CLASSIFIED';\n  position: absolute;\n  top: -25px;\n  right: -15px;\n  font-size: 10px;\n  font-weight: bold;\n  color: ITEMS[pinnedCard] : null\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"size-full w-full flex flex-col justify-end items-center pb-10 relative\"\u003e\n \n\n      {/* Pinned Card */}\n      \u003cAnimatePresence\u003e\n        {pinnedCard !== null \u0026\u0026 pinnedItem \u0026\u0026 (\n          \u003cmotion.div\n            initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}\n            animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}\n            exit={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}\n            transition={{ duration: 0.4, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}\n            className=\"absolute bottom-20 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-0\"\n          \u003e\n            \u003cmotion.div\n              layoutId={&#96;typer-item-${pinnedCard}&#96;}\n              className=\"overflow-clip rounded-2xl flex ## Summary

Redesigned the timeline UI using Three.js and React Three Fiber, based on the reference design.

### Created Components

1. **3D Z-Axis Timeline Component** (`apps/app/src/features/timeline/3d-z-axis-timeline.tsx`)
   - Scroll-based 3D navigation along the Z-axis
   - Event cards positioned in 3D space with depth-based opacity
   - Year labels that appear for each unique year
   - Classification colors and icons matching the reference design
   - Smooth camera movement based on scroll position

2. **Features Implemented**
   - 3D event cards with HTML overlays showing event details
   - Scroll-based camera movement along Z-axis
   - Navigation controls (left sidebar with year indicators, right sidebar with prev/next buttons)
   - Progress indicator showing current position
   - Stars background animation
   - Grid helper for depth perception
   - Hover effects and active state highlighting
   - Empty state handling

3. **Integration**
   - Integrated with `TimelineViews` component
   - Replaced the "3D Journey" placeholder view
   - Uses existing `EventsRecord` data structure from Xata
   - Compatible with existing view selector

### Key Features

- 3D perspective: Events arranged along the Z-axis with scroll-based navigation
- Visual design: Classification colors, icons, and styling matching the reference
- Performance: Uses React Three Fiber optimizations and proper memoization
- User experience: Smooth scrolling, navigation controls, and visual feedback
- Data integration: Works with existing Xata events data structure

### Usage

Select "3D Journey" from the view selector on the timeline page to view the new 3D timeline. The component automatically processes events, groups them by year, and creates an interactive 3D experience.

The component is ready to use and follows the project's coding standards and patterns.
